title: Shyam Narayan Chouksey v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Shyam Narayan Chouksey v. Union of India, (2018) 2 SCC 574
content.holding: The Court modified its earlier interim directions concerning the National Anthem in cinema halls and addressed exemptions and the limits of compulsory display.
content.relevance: Modern illustration of the judicial treatment of National Anthem-related obligations.
